name: liquidity_provision_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, institutional VWAP algorithms account for ~20-30% of daily buy-side volume and operate with a natural mean-reverting footprint: when NIFTY briefly dips below the tight VWAP lower band (0.5 σ computed over the recent 5 minutes), VWAP algos accelerate order submission because they're getting fills at prices significantly better than their benchmark — this burst of demand drives price back toward VWAP within 15-90 seconds. The reverse applies at the upper band, where VWAP sell-side algorithms unload at favourable prices, creating a ceiling. This effect is strongest when volume participation is normal (confirming active VWAP algo presence) and VIX < 18 (in high-VIX regimes, trend/panic flow overwhelms VWAP benchmark logic).

indicators.name: session_vwap
indicators.formula: cumsum(close * volume) / cumsum(volume) from day open
indicators.purpose: Cumulative VWAP anchored to each session open — no scaling needed since VWAP is a cumulative measure, not a windowed one. Resets daily.

indicators.name: vwap_dev_bps
indicators.purpose: VWAP deviation in basis points (bps). At NIFTY ~22000, 5 bps = ~11 spot points — the original's entry threshold. Measured in bps to remain scale-invariant as NIFTY level changes.

indicators.name: dev_std_60
indicators.purpose: 60-bar (5-minute) rolling std of VWAP deviation, used to size the tight band at 0.5 σ. Original used 30 1-min bars (30 min) for the stock std. Compressed to 5 min because: (1) we hold 15-90s not 1-3 min, so the band should reflect the current microstructure regime, not the full morning session; (2) NIFTY volatility clusters intraday — a 30-min std would be too slow to track regime shifts between quiet and active periods.

indicators.name: vol_ratio_12_60
indicators.purpose: Ratio of 1-min to 5-min average volume rate. Original filters on volume_participation > 0.8 (cumulative vs historical daily profile). We use this ratio as a proxy: if current volume rate is at least 60% of the recent 5-min baseline, VWAP algos are likely active and the mean-reversion thesis holds. Avoids trading in liquidity vacuums.

conditions: vwap_dev_bps < -(band_width * dev_std_60)  — price below lower tight VWAP band
vwap_dev_bps < -dev_threshold_bps  — minimum 5 bps below VWAP (11 spot pts at NIFTY 22000)
abs(vwap_dev_bps) < trend_abort_bps  — not in a strong intraday trend (< 20 bps = 44 spot pts from VWAP)
vol_ratio_12_60 >= 0.6  — normal volume participation confirms VWAP algo presence
vix < 18  — VIX regime filter, trend flow dominates above 18
buy_ce.confirmation: All conditions met simultaneously on 5-second bar close

conditions: vwap_dev_bps > (band_width * dev_std_60)  — price above upper tight VWAP band
vwap_dev_bps > dev_threshold_bps  — minimum 5 bps above VWAP
abs(vwap_dev_bps) < trend_abort_bps  — not in strong intraday trend
buy_pe.confirmation: All conditions met simultaneously on 5-second bar close

exit.stop_rationale: 3 option pts (~6 spot pts at delta 0.5) — if price moves 6 additional spot pts beyond the entry at the tight band without reversing, the VWAP algo thesis is broken (an informed directional order has overwhelmed the mean-reversion flow). At 5 bps entry (11 spot pts from VWAP) plus 6 more pts = 17 spot pts total deviation, well outside the regime this thesis requires.
exit.target_rationale: 5 option pts (~10 spot pts) — the reversion target is VWAP, which at entry is ~11 spot pts away (5 bps at 22000). Capturing 10 spot pts (5 option pts) represents ~91% of the full reversion move, leaving a sliver at the top where VWAP algo buying pressure naturally subsides. Consistent with 30-90 second reversion typical of tight VWAP band touches on NIFTY.

filters.vix_filter: VIX < 18 — high-VIX environments see trend/panic flow overwhelm VWAP benchmarking logic
filters.time_filter: 09:25-15:20 IST — skip first 10 min (VWAP unstable, opening range dynamics dominate) and last 10 min (closing auctions create directional pressure)
filters.volume_filter: vol_ratio_12_60 >= 0.6 — requires normal volume participation; no VWAP algo presence in liquidity vacuums
filters.trend_filter: abs(vwap_dev_bps) < 20 — skip if NIFTY is 44+ spot pts from VWAP; strong intraday trends override mean reversion at this tight band threshold
filters.spread_filter: none — index options have tight spreads; not required

edge.edge_decay_risk: Low-to-medium — VWAP-benchmarked institutional flow is structurally persistent as long as institutions use VWAP as execution benchmark (industry standard). Risk is that as VWAP band reversion becomes crowded, the tight bands stop holding — mitigated by the specificity of the 5 bps / 0.5 σ entry requirement.

adaptation_notes: Original is a market-making strategy on NIFTY50 constituent stocks: post limit orders at VWAP±0.5σ bands, earn the spread when VWAP algos fill against them, hold 1-3 min for reversion. This cannot be replicated directly in our directional CE/PE framework. The adaptation extracts the directional kernel — when NIFTY's own price touches its tight VWAP band, the same institutional VWAP algo flow that made stock-level market-making profitable also predicts which direction NIFTY will move in the next 30-90 seconds. Key changes: (1) universe collapses to the NIFTY index itself; (2) market-making (spread capture) replaced by directional option buying; (3) std lookback compressed from 30 min to 5 min to match the faster 15-90s hold horizon; (4) bid-ask spread filter removed (irrelevant at index level and for limit-order execution); (5) volume participation proxy changed from cumulative-vs-historical-daily to rolling 1-min/5-min ratio (pipeline has no historical volume profiles). The VIX filter and trend abort filter are preserved directly from the original.
weaknesses: VWAP reversion signals on NIFTY are already partially captured by vwap_mean_reversion_v18 (deep) and v19 (moderate); this tight-band version adds a third variant — differentiation relies on the 5-bps threshold being tight enough to avoid overlap
The 5-min rolling std shrinks the band during low-volatility periods, potentially generating too many false signals when NIFTY oscillates around VWAP with no VWAP algo catalysts
Session VWAP anchoring means early-session signals (09:25-10:00) use an unstable VWAP computed from only 60-120 bars; first real signals are most reliable after 10:00
